_metadata.title: ComplianceLint Interim Standard for EU AI Act Article 11: Technical Documentation
_metadata.disclaimer: This is an interim checklist developed by ComplianceLint. It is not a harmonised standard and does not itself give a presumption of conformity. No separate harmonised standard or European standardisation deliverable is requested specifically for Article 11 technical documentation. Commission Implementing Decision C(2025) 3871 requires the Article 11 requirements to be fully covered in the other requested standards and deliverables, particularly the quality-management-system work.
basis: EU AI Act Annex IV (technical documentation requirements)
EU AI Act Recital 68 (legislative intent on documentation)
ISO/IEC TR 24028:2020 — Overview of trustworthiness in AI
ISO/IEC 23894:2023 — Guidance on risk management for AI
ISO/IEC TR 24029-1:2021 — Assessment of robustness of neural networks
Google Model Cards for Model Reporting
_metadata.awaiting_standard: No separate harmonised standard or European standardisation deliverable is requested specifically for Article 11 technical documentation. Commission Implementing Decision C(2025) 3871 requires the Article 11 requirements to be fully covered in the other requested standards and deliverables, particularly the quality-management-system work.

requirements.title: System Description (Annex IV, Section 1)
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST maintain a README or equivalent document providing a general description of the AI system.
requirements.rationale: Annex IV(1) requires 'a general description of the AI system', including its intended purpose, the name of the provider and the version of the system (point (a)) and, where applicable, how it interacts with, or can be used to interact with, hardware or software that is not part of the AI system itself (point (b)).
required_content: Versions of relevant software or firmware
Forms of market placement (SaaS, on-premise, embedded)
System description in plain language for non-technical users

requirements.title: Architecture Documentation (Annex IV, Section 2)
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST maintain architecture documentation describing system elements and the development process.
requirements.rationale: Annex IV(2) requires 'a detailed description of the elements of the AI system and of the process for its development', including the design specifications (point (b)) and the system architecture (point (c)).
required_content: Key design choices and their rationale

requirements.title: API / Interface Documentation (Annex IV, points 1(d), 2(b) and 3)
requirements.requirement: The provider SHOULD document relevant input requirements, expected outputs and interface/API arrangements, where applicable, within the Annex IV technical documentation; OpenAPI/Swagger is an optional format (Annex IV(2)(b), (3), (1)(d)).
requirements.rationale: Annex IV(2)(b) requires 'the description of the expected output and output quality of the system', Annex IV(3) requires 'specifications on input data, as appropriate', and Annex IV(1)(d) names APIs among the forms in which the AI system is placed on the market or put into service. An API specification is one practical way to document these points; the Regulation does not prescribe a format.

requirements.title: Design and Development Documentation (Annex IV, points 2(b) to 2(d))
requirements.requirement: The technical documentation MUST describe, as applicable, the design specifications and key design choices, the system architecture and computational resources, and the data requirements and training methodologies (Annex IV(2)(b)–(d)); a model card is one possible format.
requirements.rationale: Annex IV(2)(b)-(d) requires documentation of design specifications, computational resources, training methodologies, training data information, and key design choices. The Regulation does not require a separate document called a model card.
required_content: Evaluation metrics and performance on benchmarks

requirements.title: Testing Documentation (Annex IV, point 2(g))
requirements.requirement: The technical documentation MUST include, as applicable, the validation and testing procedures, datasets and characteristics, relevant metrics, and dated and signed test logs and reports (Annex IV(2)(g)).
requirements.rationale: Annex IV(2)(g) requires 'the validation and testing procedures used, including information about the validation and testing data used and their main characteristics; metrics used to measure accuracy, robustness and compliance with other relevant requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, as well as potentially discriminatory impacts; test logs and all test reports dated and signed by the responsible persons'.

requirements.title: Changes Through the Lifecycle
requirements.requirement: The technical documentation MUST describe relevant changes made by the provider to the system through its lifecycle and MUST be kept up to date (Annex IV(6), Article 11(1)); a change log is one possible format.
requirements.rationale: Annex IV(6) requires 'a description of relevant changes made by the provider to the system through its lifecycle', and Art. 11(1) requires the technical documentation to be 'kept up-to date'. A change log is a common way to track this; the Regulation does not prescribe its format.

requirements.title: Forms of Placing on the Market or Putting into Service (Annex IV, point 1(d))
requirements.requirement: The technical documentation MUST describe all the forms in which the AI system is placed on the market or put into service, including APIs where relevant (Annex IV(1)(d)); a separate deployment guide is optional.
requirements.rationale: Annex IV(1)(d) requires 'the description of all the forms in which the AI system is placed on the market or put into service, such as software packages embedded into hardware, downloads, or APIs'. Deployment documentation is one way to provide this information.
acceptable_implementations: CI/CD pipeline configuration with deployment steps

scoring.compliant: R01 + R02 + R04 + R05 met, and at least 2 of R03, R06, R07 met
scoring.partial: R01 met + at least 3 others met
scoring.non_compliant: R01 not met, or fewer than 3 requirements met
